title: ECMAScript standardization and modern evolution
learningObjectives: Explain ecmascript standardization and modern evolution and describe JavaScript's role in web development.

understand.concept: ECMAScript is the standard that defines the core JavaScript language. TC39 develops the standard through proposals and yearly editions. Browser APIs such as the DOM are separate web platform interfaces that JavaScript code can use but that are not themselves defined by ECMAScript.
understand.whyItMatters: Separating the language from host APIs helps explain why some JavaScript features work in different runtimes while browser-specific APIs do not exist everywhere.
understand.analogy: ECMAScript is the language rulebook; browser APIs are tools supplied by the environment where the code runs.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; language standards and host runtime APIs have precise technical boundaries.

explain.narrative: The example uses core language features. The DOM insertion is a browser API provided by the host environment.

examples.explanation: The example uses core language features. The DOM insertion is a browser API provided by the host environment.
examples.expectedOutput: A browser page displays or updates text using JavaScript.

practise.guidedTask: Classify examples such as arrays, promises, document.querySelector, and fetch as language features or host APIs. Explain your choices.
practise.independentTask: Create a short explanation and runnable example that separates core JavaScript language features from browser-specific APIs.
hints: Identify the runtime before using host APIs.
Use original examples and explain each line.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>ECMAScript standardization and modern evolution</title></head><body>
<script>const values=[1,2,3];const doubled=values.map(value=>value*2);document.body.insertAdjacentText('beforeend',doubled.join(', '));</script>
</body></html>
practice.resetCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>ECMAScript standardization and modern evolution</title></head><body>
<script>const values=[1,2,3];const doubled=values.map(value=>value*2);document.body.insertAdjacentText('beforeend',doubled.join(', '));</script>
</body></html>

questions.prompt: Which standard specifies the core JavaScript language?
questions.explanation: ECMAScript defines the core JavaScript language.

questions.prompt: What should you identify before using a JavaScript API?
questions.explanation: Available APIs depend on whether code runs in a browser, server runtime, or another host.
